title: Crane NXT Announces Dates for First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Earnings Call
summary: WALTHAM, Mass., April 09, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Crane NXT, Co. (NYSE: CXT), a premier industrial technology company, today announced its schedule for the company’s first quarter 2026 results. Earnings Release: Wednesday, May 6, 2026, after close of market by public distribution. To access the earnings release, please visit the Investors section of Crane NXT’s website at www.cranenxt.com . Earnings Call: Thursday, May 7, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. To access the webcast, please visit the Investors section of Crane NXT’s website at www.cranenxt.com . The archived webcast will be available on the company’s website. About Crane NXT, Co. Crane NXT is a global leader in authentication and traceability technologies that secure, detect, and authenticate what matters most to its customers.
